args.mock_news: Fed minutes signal patience on rate cuts. US job market added 180K jobs in December. Oil prices rose 3% on OPEC+ supply cuts. China PMI fell below 50 for second consecutive month. European inflation eased to 2.3%. US consumer confidence index at 105, beating expectations. Tech sector earnings season begins next week with high expectations. Dollar strengthened against EM currencies. Treasury yields: 10-year at 4.5%. Corporate bond spreads tightening.

CPI came in at 3.1%, slightly above 3.0% consensus. Fed officials signal higher-for-longer stance. Bank earnings season strong: JP Morgan, Goldman beat estimates. Tech layoffs continue at mid-sized companies. China exports grew 5% YoY. Brent crude at $82, stable. Gold reached $2,700 on safe-haven demand. Yen weakened to 160 vs dollar. India GDP growth 7.2% for fiscal year. US 10-year Treasury yield at 4.6%.

US retail sales beat expectations at +0.4% MoM. Housing starts declined 8% on mortgage rate pressure. Fed's Waller: inflation progress stalling. ECB held rates steady as expected. Japan raised rates 25bps surprising markets. Nvidia AI chip demand: hyperscalers doubled capex guidance. EM capital outflows accelerating. VIX rose to 22 on uncertainty. Copper prices rising on China stimulus expectations. US Q4 GDP estimate: 2.8% annualized.

FOMC held rates at 4.5-4.75% as expected. Powell: two cuts possible in 2026 if inflation cooperates. Mega-cap tech earnings: strong AI-related capex. EU proposed new digital services regulation. Japan yen at 155 post rate hike stabilization. Oil: WTI $80, OPEC+ compliance 94%. US unemployment claims rose slightly to 225K. Corporate buyback activity at record levels. Gold at $2,750. China stimulus: $300B infrastructure package announced.

US ISM Manufacturing PMI at 51.2, first expansion in 18 months. Jobs report: 220K added, unemployment stable at 4.1%. Fed's Daly: patience on cuts needed. European energy prices stable. Semiconductor industry outlook upgraded by SEMI trade group. Dollar index (DXY) at 104. 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.3% on cooler inflation expectations. AI infrastructure spending wave driving data center REITs. Emerging markets: Brazil and India outperforming YTD. Crypto Bitcoin at $98K.
